spans.s: ज्यो vt. 1Ā (pres. ज्यवते) 1. To advise, to instruct; 2. to observe any religious obligation.
ज्योतिष (I) a. (f. षी) Astronomical, astrological.
ज्योतिष (II) m. An astronomer or astrologer.
ज्योतिष (III) n. 1. Astronomy or astrology; 2. a small treatise on astronomy considered as one of the six Vedāṅgas.
ज्योतिष (I) a. (f. षी) Astronomical, astrological.
ज्योतिषी f. A planet, a star, a luminary.
ज्योतिष-विद्या f. astronomical or astrological science.
ज्योतिष्क m. A planet, a star, a luminary.
ज्योतिस् (I) m. 1. Fire; 2. the sun.

ज्योतिस् (II) n. 1. Light, lustre, brightness, R.ii.75; 2. light regarded as the supreme spirit, Bg.xiii.17; 3. lightning; 4. the faculty of seeing; 5. a heavenly body, a luminary, ज्योतिषां रविरंशुमान् Bg.x.21.
ज्योतिस्-इंग, -इंगण m. the firefly.
ज्योतिस्-इंग, -इंगण m. the firefly.
ज्योतिष्कण m. a spark of fire, R.xv.52.
ज्योतिर्गण m. the heavenly bodies collectively.
ज्योतिश्चक्र n. the zodiac.
ज्योतिर्ज्ञ a. an astronomer or astrologer.
ज्योतिर्मंडल n. the stellar sphere.
ज्योतिर्मय a. starry, consisting of stars, K.S.vi.3, R.xv.59.
ज्योतिष्मत् (I) a. illuminated, bright, नक्षत्रताराग्रहसकुलापि ज्योतिष्मती चन्द्रमसेव रात्रिः R.vi.22.
ज्योतिष्मत् (II) m. the sun.
ज्योतिष्मती f. 1. the night illuminated by stars; 2. peaceful state of mind (in Yoga phil.).
ज्योतीरथ m. the polar star.
ज्योतिर्विद् m. an astronomer or astrologer.
ज्योतिर्विद्या f. astronomy or astrology.
ज्योतिःशास्त्र n. astronomy or astrology.
ज्योतिश्शास्त्र n. astronomy or astrology.
ज्योतिष्टोम m. a Soma sacrifice considered as the typical form of a whole class of sacrificial ceremonies.
ज्योत्स्ना f. 1. Moonlight, न हि संहरते ज्योत्स्नां चंद्रश्छांडालवेश्मनि Hit.i.; 2. light in general.
ज्योत्स्ना-ईश m. the moon.
ज्योत्स्ना-प्रिय m. the chakora bird.
ज्योत्स्ना-वृक्ष m. a lamp-stand, a candle-stick.
ज्योत्स्नी f. A moon-light night.
